name: operations.demands

list.description: Read full native funding-demand tasks within the verified inquiry scope.

parameters.name: execute-from
parameters.description: Inclusive native execution-time lower bound YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, without an offset; source timezone unknown.

parameters.name: execute-to
parameters.description: Inclusive native execution-time upper bound YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, at or after execute-from; source timezone unknown.

purpose: Inspect native funding-demand tasks through bounded inquiry-only requests.

fields.name: taskId
fields.meaning: Native task identity, distinct from sourceId.

fields.name: sourceId
fields.meaning: Associated source reference; not the task primary identity.

fields.name: amount
fields.meaning: Finite native decimal text, retained without numeric conversion.

fields.name: executeTime
fields.meaning: Native execution timestamp; source timezone unknown, distinct from capture time.

identity_description: Native taskId identifies one returned record within the tenant and exact acquisition scope.
limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant and FUND_REQUIRE source. One GET /riskActionTaskQuery.json uses a serialized riskActionTaskQueryVO, rowStart=0 and pageSize=5000.
Both offset-free execution-time bounds are required. Public values use T; wire values use a space. Equal bounds are permitted and native boundaries are inclusive. No timezone is inferred.

Native result.dataValue records and result.count describe the queried task scope. Counts or arrivals above 5000 are rejected; narrow the bounds. No offset fallback, automatic partitioning or alternate source.
All native fields, types, nesting and unknown values are retained. No detail lookup, source join or status interpretation.

The host SDK owns retries, completeness and publication. Duplicate/conflicting identities and count gaps remain incomplete; strict refresh preserves the prior capture on rejection. Widths are historical successful request sizes, not measured backend maxima.
